CHAPTER 01
Market size

Description: In 2025, the Dutch e-commerce market was valued at around 35.7 billion euros. The Netherlands’ e-commerce market decreased slightly in 2025 when compared to 2024. In 2024, Dutch consumers spent roughly 36 billion euros on online purchases and
orders. This makes the country the seventh-largest e-commerce market in Europe in absolute terms and online shopping made up more than three percent of their GDP. Consequently, around 345 million online purchases were made by 14.1 [...] Read more
Note(s): Netherlands; 2005 to 2025
Source(s): PostNL; Thuiswinkel.org
